groups.label: #1055 — cross-case-type CBR retrieval
groups.message:
feat(#1055): cross-case-type CBR retrieval

Add crossType flag to CbrConfig for querying across all case definition
types within a domain. CbrRetrievalService uses CbrQuery.crossType()
(AllInDomain scope) when enabled, threading per-result caseType from
ScoredCbrCase into RetrievedExperience.

Changes:
- CbrConfig.crossType (boolean, default false, mutually exclusive with caseType)
- RetrievedExperience.caseType (nullable String, 9th component)
- CbrRetrievalService branches on crossType for query construction
- CbrConfigDeserializer parses crossType from YAML
- Fix ScoredCbrCase 2-arg constructor calls (upstream API change)
- CLAUDE.md updated

Closes #1055

groups.label: #1056 — CbrCaseRetainObserver enrichment
groups.message:
feat(#1056): enrich CbrCaseRetainObserver problem/solution with metadata

CbrCaseRetainObserver now composes meaningful problem text from case
definition metadata (title, summary) and app-defined JQ expressions,
and appends labels/types to the solution for discoverability.

Changes:
- CbrConfig.problemDescription (JQ expression for app-specific problem extraction)
- buildProblem(): JQ expression -> title+summary -> caseType fallback chain
- buildSolution(): appends definition labels and types to trace string
- CbrConfigDeserializer parses problemDescription from YAML
- CLAUDE.md updated

Closes #1056

groups.label: #1054 — pre-startCase CBR retrieval
groups.message:
feat(#1054): CbrRetrievalService.retrieveForSelection() — pre-startCase CBR

Add retrieveForSelection() overload that queries CBR without requiring
a CaseInstance or CaseDefinition. Takes pre-extracted features, domain,
and scoring parameters directly. Always uses cross-type queries
(AllInDomain scope) for comparing outcomes across case definition types.

Consumers use this at situation evaluation time to rank case definitions
by past outcome quality before calling startCase().

Closes #1054
